judge: AV-07 fresh independent visual judge, part 2
method: Read JUDGE_PROMPT.md and CHECKLIST.md, verified the candidate SHA256, then opened every regular pair_NNN and strip_NNN JPG for NNN 013 through 025 individually at original detail. Scored each boundary against all 11 checklist items and the locked transition and photo-label rules. No sampling was used.

entries.note: Plan declares a bare TALK join plus punch NEAR. The take and roughly 20 percent framing step change at the cut, followed by the planned punch treatment. Hair and body framing remain safe.
Five-frame strip confirms the declared TALK join and punch NEAR onset. The visible take change is paired with the allowed framing step and is not an exposed same-size splice.
Plan declares a bare TALK join plus punch FAR. The instant framing reset is the allowed roughly 20 percent TALK-cut step, with no hair crop or off-center body cut.
Five-frame strip shows the declared join and FAR reset. The framing change covers the take change, and the following frames are stable and properly framed.
Plan declares cards out and lower third out. The lower-third text is visibly fading at the boundary while TALK remains continuous.
Five-frame strip confirms the planned lower-third fade-out. No black frame, freeze, framing fault, or leftover card is visible.
Plan declares the card and lower third fully out. The TALK frame is clean after the completed fade.
Five-frame strip shows the final planned removal of the card and lower third with uninterrupted TALK footage and no blank or frozen frame.
Plan declares TALK to the full-bleed real_red_shorts photo. No flash is used on the full-bleed photo. Exactly one real-photo label appears above and to the right of Dan, clear of his face and abs.
Five-frame strip confirms the declared full-bleed photo onset. The single real-photo label is legible and remains off Dan's face and abs, with no flash on the photo.
Plan declares a full-bleed real-photo swap from real_red_shorts to real_park_close. Each side has exactly one real-photo label, and both placements are clear of Dan's face and abs.
Five-frame strip shows the declared photo-to-photo cut without a flash. The new image has exactly one safe label to the left of Dan's shoulder, not over his face or abs.
The internal card-overlay handoff is visually stable. The real_park_close image retains exactly one legible label, safely positioned off Dan's face and abs.
Five-frame strip remains visually stable through the overlay handoff. No duplicate label, flash, black frame, freeze, or card junk appears.
Plan declares the real photo out and full-bleed AI goal photo in. No flash is used on the full-bleed photo. The AI-GENERATED label is the only label and is clear of Dan's face and abs.
Five-frame strip confirms the declared real-to-AI full-bleed photo cut. The single AI label is legible and safely placed to the left of Dan's head and torso.
Plan declares the full-bleed AI goal out and the phone card in. The card appears complete with one AI-generated disclosure, and no flash is required for this photo-to-card change.
Five-frame strip shows the declared card onset cleanly. The phone image, frame, disclosure, and background render without garbling, clipping, placeholder text, or black frames.
The declared join inside the phone-card sequence has no visible jump in the minus-one to zero pair. Card geometry and disclosure remain stable.
Five-frame strip confirms a visually continuous phone-card join with no exposed subject jump, freeze, black frame, or drifting card.
Plan declares the card out and TALK back in. The white flash is present exactly on the permitted return from a card to TALK.
Five-frame strip shows the expected flash blooming across the return from the card to TALK. The flash is intentional, not a black or corrupt frame.
Plan declares TALK out and the card background in. No flash is used because this is TALK to card, not a return to TALK. The olive panel is the planned first stage before its content reveal.
Five-frame strip confirms the planned card panel onset. The one-frame separation before card content starts is declared by the next boundary and is not a placeholder or frozen beat.
Plan declares card@99.166 content in after the panel onset. The first reveal frame is intentionally subtle and contains no malformed or off-screen text.
Five-frame strip shows the planned content reveal beginning inside the already-present olive card. No placeholder, garbled type, black frame, or unintended flash is visible.
